bindings.normalized_statement: theorem covered_card_le {C T : Type*} [DecidableEq T] (s : Finset C) (incident : C → Finset T) (d : ℕ) (hd : ∀ c ∈ s, (incident c).card ≤ d) : (s.biUnion incident).card ≤ s.card * d

theorem sharing_pairs_card_le {C T : Type*} [Fintype C] [DecidableEq T] (incident : C → Finset T) (d : ℕ) (hd : ∀ c, (incident c).card ≤ d) : ((Finset.univ : Finset C).biUnion (fun c => (incident c) ×ˢ (incident c))).card ≤ Fintype.card C * d^2

theorem block_projection_image [DecidableEq I] (A : Matrix R C K) (block : R → I) (owner : C → I) (x : C → K) (s : I → K) (hsupport : ∀ r c, owner c ≠ block r → A r c = 0) (hvalue : A *ᵥ x = s ∘ block) (i : I) : A *ᵥ (fun c => if owner c = i then x c else 0) = fun r => if block r = i then s i else 0

theorem separated_block_kernel_tags [DecidableEq I] [Fintype I] (A : Matrix R C K) (block : R → I) (owner : C → I) (x : C → K) (s : I → K) (hsupport : ∀ r c, owner c ≠ block r → A r c = 0) (hvalue : A *ᵥ x = s ∘ block) (hs : ∀ i, s i ≠ 0) (y : R → K) (hy : y ᵥ* A = 0) (tag : I → K) : ∑ r, y r * tag (block r) = 0
